svg.title: A hidden layer makes XOR separable
svg.desc: A single perceptron can represent linearly separable AND and OR but not XOR. A hidden layer can form OR and AND features and combine them to compute XOR.

g.text: A hidden layer makes XOR separable
A perceptron draws one threshold boundary; hidden features let an MLP solve XOR.
one threshold boundary can separate these
A hidden layer builds features that make XOR separable.
